items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: The only person, I think, that I can remember, was his brother Eddie, who was at that time a bass player

ctx.x: Yeah, she seems to have. When Nat used to rehearse his big band at your house, who was in that big band, do you remember?

I can't remember, frankly. The only person, I think, that I can remember, was his brother Eddie, who was at that time a bass player, and Eddie of course has gone on also. Eddie later got with a group, he had a group, I can't remember what they called themselves, but he had an entertaining group, something like four or five people in it. And I can't -- I can't remember anybody else in the band, I just can't, because when they used to rehearse, well they -- not only would his band be there, some of the other guys…
He was such a tremendous pianist, you know, and all the guys just loved to play with him, you know. All of them would.
